scope: Targeted Phase 5 extraction from the two cached official March of the Machine: The Aftermath stories, 'She Who Breaks the World' (2023-05-01) and 'Beyond Repair' (2023-05-02). Statements made in dialogue or a character's private thoughts are graded IMPLIED with a limitation. PRELIMINARY_RESEARCH; not owner approved.

entities.name: Phyrexian invasion of the Multiverse (March of the Machine)

claims.subject: teferi

quotes.quote: Teferi's spark had faded sometime after the invasion. Koth's as well.

claims.summary: Teferi's spark faded after the Phyrexian invasion.

claims.subject: koth

quotes.quote: Teferi's spark had faded sometime after the invasion. Koth's as well.

claims.summary: Koth's spark faded after the Phyrexian invasion.

claims.subject: nissa_revane

quotes.quote: They'd all lost their sparks, but only Nissa still wanted to planeswalk.
she can no longer planeswalk. I can, but

claims.summary: After the invasion Nissa can no longer planeswalk, although she still wants to.
claims.limitation: The second quote is Ajani's dialogue; the story does not establish exactly how her spark was lost.

claims.subject: karn

quotes.quote: Just that morning, Karn and Koth had finished roofing the last house in a new village.
Koth and Karn were forging a new one.

claims.summary: Karn and Koth build a new home for the Mirran refugees on Zhalfir.

claims.subject: teferi
claims.summary: After the invasion Teferi has his homeland of Zhalfir again.

claims.subject: chandra_nalaar

quotes.quote: She does not watch Chandra planeswalk away, but Nissa can still smell the scent she leaves behind
"Go, then, find Ajani, and I'll just wait here."

claims.summary: Chandra planeswalks away from Zhalfir to find Ajani, leaving Nissa behind.

claims.subject: wrenn

quotes.quote: When Wrenn knit her fragile body into the sinew of the Invasion Tree
sitting with her legs crossed beside the sprout that used to be Wrenn

claims.summary: Wrenn knit herself into the Invasion Tree and is now a sprout growing on Zhalfir.

claims.subject: nahiri

quotes.quote: Then again, she was no longer a Planeswalker.
Her last hope at regaining her power—at becoming a Planeswalker once more—was gone.

claims.summary: Nahiri lost her spark in the Skyclave, and her last hope of recovering it was destroyed.
claims.limitation: Her spark is later found in the Skyclave chamber where she had bound herself, apparently fuelling the engine; the story does not say exactly how it left her.

claims.subject: ajani

quotes.quote: When she'd last seen him, it had been as Elesh Norn's most faithful evangel, her most favored lieutenant.

claims.summary: As a Phyrexian, Ajani was Elesh Norn's most faithful evangel and favored lieutenant.
claims.limitation: Past state; Ajani has been cleansed of Phyrexia by the time of the story.

claims.subject: ajani

quotes.quote: You slaughtered the gods of Theros. You murdered Jaya Ballard.

claims.summary: Nahiri accuses Ajani of murdering Jaya Ballard and slaughtering the gods of Theros.
claims.limitation: An accusation in Nahiri's dialogue, not narration; Ajani reacts with grief and fury but does not confirm.

claims.subject: nahiri

quotes.quote: "Whatever it takes, I swear. No Planeswalker will set foot on Zendikar ever again."

claims.summary: Nahiri swears that no Planeswalker will set foot on Zendikar again.

claims.subject: ajani

quotes.quote: He had come to Zendikar seeking her out specifically.

claims.summary: Ajani came to Zendikar to find Nahiri.
claims.limitation: Narrated from Nahiri's point of view; his stated purpose is to help her.

remaining: Both MAT stories are targeted, not exhaustive; the other MAT stories are not in the cached inventory
The lightning-beast portal on Zhalfir is not graded
